changes.summary: AFL Rosters on a phone: the position headers (Quarterbacks, Running backs…) now run the full width of the card, and the sort chips scroll inside their card and read like TheLeague's — 'Pts ↓', no spelled-out 'sorted descending'.
changes.impact: The AFL roster page's phone layout had lost every AFL-specific rule it was styled with, so the headers shrank to their label and the chips spilled off the right edge.
